$Comment: The channel aura the Disenchanting Table's Draw beat puts on the worker's double (Actions/Disenchant.json, the Draw step's Presentation.Effect with Target Puppet): a green-gold glow over the model, a mossy underglow and slow Life-essence motes rising off the figure while it channels. On the double the station keeps the clock and strips the effect at the session's end; on a worker with no double it lands on the player instead, where this Duration bounds it.
